steps.observation: Work on this for 30 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three effective strategies cities can use to cut carbon emissions:

1. Low-carbon transportation  
   • Expand and improve public transit (electric buses, light rail)  
   • Build safe bike lanes and pedestrian zones to encourage non-motorized travel  
   • Incentivize electric vehicles with charging infrastructure and preferential parking

2. Energy-efficient buildings  
   • Retrofit existing homes and offices with better insulation, efficient windows, and smart thermostats  
   • Adopt strict green building standards for all new construction (e.g., passive house or net-zero design)  
   • Implement real-time energy monitoring and demand-response programs

3. Renewable energy integration  
   • Install distributed solar (rooftops, facades) and incentivize community solar projects  
   • Develop district heating/cooling networks powered by waste heat or biomass  
   • Partner with utilities on large-scale clean power purchases (wind, solar, hydro)
